subtitle: Shintsha inhlamvu eyodwa
short_description: Khuphuka usuka egameni elilodwa uye kwelinye, inhlamvu eyodwa ngesinyathelo.
description:
Ipuzzle yamagama esiNgisi: qala ngegama elilodwa ufinyelele igama lenjongo ngokushintsha inhlamvu eyodwa ngesikhathi, usebenzisa amakhadi amagama atholakalayo kuphela. Ibhodi ngalinye linikeza inani elinembile lezinyathelo, ubude bendlela emfushane kunazo zonke.

Thepha ikhadi legama elifanelekile elilandelayo. Uhlaka lwamanje, injongo nenani lezinyathelo zakho kuhlala kusikrini.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
